name: Virtual Desktop
summary: Virtual Desktop 串流的面捕，直接读它写的共享内存 BodyState，不需要 VRCFT。
description: 读 VirtualDesktop.BodyState 与同名事件（裸名按 .NET OpenFileMapping 实际行为确认，未自造 Local\ 前缀）。FaceState 360 字节、既无版本号也无计数前缀，故用双快照比对防半更新，映射长度先校验、越界读拒绝且不部分写出。bit0 门控 70 权重→69 个 Unified 形状；眼 valid 时由双眼 Pose 出注视。上游无数据时把瞳孔伪造成 5mm，本模块不写瞳孔。
usage: 1. VD 串流端 ≥1.30 开启面部转发、头显启用面捕。2. 关闭 VRCFaceTracking。3. 设为启动并重启引擎。4. 未验证：眼 Pose 坐标系、FaceFlags 高位、置信度语义。

en.summary: Virtual Desktop face tracking read straight from its BodyState shared memory — no VRCFT.
en.description: Consumes the VirtualDesktop.BodyState mapping and event (bare names confirmed against .NET's OpenFileMapping behaviour, no invented prefix). FaceState is 360 bytes with neither version nor counter, so two-snapshot comparison guards torn reads and lengths are validated before reading. bit0 gates 70 weights onto 69 shapes; per-eye gaze comes from the poses when valid. Pupil is deliberately not written because upstream fakes 5mm.
en.usage: 1. VD Streamer 1.30+ with face forwarding on. 2. Quit VRCFaceTracking. 3. Enable the module and restart the engine. 4. Untested: pose frame, high FaceFlags bits, confidence semantics.
